(src/keithley_daq6510/instrument.py:10); VisaInstrument forwards query and command to pyvisa (src/keithley_daq6510/visa_instrument.py:24-28). The package exposes that reply as the read-only state field idn and as the read extension x-cap.croesnick.identity.v1. NOT COVERED: measurements, channels, ranges, triggers, status, outputs and every other DAQ6510 function, because the clone declares no such command; :STATus:CLEar appears only as a pyvisa-sim dialogue with no reply (tests/fixtures/devices.yml:11) and is not exposed. No numeric write or numeric invoke input exists, so there is no Limit, no operator-required bound, no site-limits.example.json and no stop or e-stop claim; risk R0 reflects that the driver reads a string and writes no device state. The fake is a package-local SCPI transport stand-in, not the upstream simulator (clone code is never imported or run); its identity reply is placeholder test data from tests/fixtures/devices.yml:10, not a fact about an attached instrument. check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run; gate.digest is the digest the last check printed.
